protocol.execution_order: all14 positive/regression prefixes finalized and independently checked before real transcriptions; then two real, then78 negatives, same search

family.duplicates_removed: 6 common P3 * 256 masks has a global-reversal redundancy of 2; canonical Q endpoints ascending removes it
family.formula: key[3*o+c] = ASCII_index(A24[3*P8[o] + Q_m[2-c if bit(mask,o) else c]])
family.mask: all integers 0..255; bit o reverses input arcs 1<->3 for orientation o
family.round10_included: all Q with mask=0 or mask=255; 241920 distinct keys
family.scope: No glyph corrections, no position reordering, no state/dot commands. Same fixed triples, common middle rank; not all substitutions, not all 6^8 internal permutations.

protocol.interpretation: Exploratory family selected after ten rounds. Exact numerical max does not mean semantic solution or exclusion of every English reading; no new original manuscript evidence.

negative_controls.coupling: Same RNG initial state, different graphs consume it differently. NOT identical positional permutations and not a validated joint null for max across versions.
negative_controls.method: archived directed-bigram Euler shuffle with fixed endpoints, independently uniform for each transcription; paired by replicate using same reset RNG seed per replicate for both versions
negative_controls.selection: Each version analyzed separately. No choosing better version or multiplying p-values. Controls preserve full glyph counts, directed bigrams, endpoints, not necessarily prefix counts.
negative_controls.tail: (1+count(test_control>=test_real-1e-10))/(39+1); descriptive conditional tail, not probability true/false plaintext; no global adaptive-search correction

objective.character: unchanged archived data/english_merged24_v5.npz, mean natural log conditional 4gram in original window order
objective.key_selection: Strict largest float64 S43; if EXACT equal, smallest canonical key ID. All exact ties retained. 1e-10 is reporting comparison tolerance for tail counts only, not key selection.
objective.test: Last44 decrypted once with selected key, scored with same C44+0.5*W44 using within-suffix windows only. No cross-boundary 4grams, no suffix-based key choice, stopping, tuning or tie breaking.
objective.train: S43 = C43 + 0.5*W43 only on first 43 glyphs
objective.whole87: Only readout with training-selected key; no full-text fit in this round
objective.word: unchanged merged24 TextBlob unigram Viterbi; max word24, unknown-8/letter, partial endpoints -2; no added words

positive_controls.key_generation: uniform P8 permutation, uniform m in0..2, uniform mask in1..254 (exclude old common-order subfamily); independent by excerpt order
positive_controls.limitations: convenience linked letter openings, repeated recipients, merged letters; no guarantee external dictionary lacks author
positive_controls.normalization: reuse exactly the existing 87 normalized ASCII letters; j->i and v->u; no modernizing spelling
positive_controls.source: unchanged archived round10 letter excerpts; 12 Bailey/Brewer plus 2 round8 regressions
positive_controls.status: All 14 texts were already seen in prior rounds. Regression/sensitivity tests, NOT independent new historical holdouts. Fresh nonuniform direction masks, unknown to solver.

search.budget: All 40320 P8 * 3 canonical Q * 256 masks. No top-K cut, stochastic search, or data-dependent early stopping.
search.checkpoint: atomic NPZ+JSON after each P8 block, before next block; cumulative score, exact-tie keys, bounds, sparse complete scores, hashes
search.method: Exact enumeration of all 30965760 character scores per input; evaluate W unless admissible ambiguity-word upper bound proves S cannot match incumbent. Bound allows independent lo/hi choices at every position, a superset of all 256 masks for fixed P8,m.
search.prune: C+.5*W_upper < incumbent - 1e-9; conservative float safety margin
search.sequential_order: P8 lexicographic, m0..2. Within group character champion first then remaining mask IDs ascending; ties resolved by canonical ID regardless of order

verification.development: 5 complete two-P8 synthetic toy exhaustive comparisons, before freeze; no actual case scores used
verification.independent: Python word scorer and direct C evaluation of selected keys; brute full masks on deterministic sampled blocks; checkpoint chaining, admissible bound checks; reencrypt all87; regenerate seeds; verify7500oldfiles
verification.initial: existing process/files inventory and archive SHA256; no prior round11 found in accessible runtime/archives; withdrawn12/12 not evidence
verification.repeat_rule: missing case name substituted ONLY by actual first old-regression case name before freeze
